dedupe_keys.name: bangladesh hourly power generation demand load shedding and fuel mix compiled from pgcb dispatch reports 2015 2026

description: These two community releases compile hourly national electricity statistics for Bangladesh from the public dispatch data of the Power Grid Company of Bangladesh (PGCB). One, by Md Ibrahim Shekh and Rakibul Hasan Rafi on Mendeley Data, scrapes the PGCB ERP portal from April 2015 to March 2026 (over 92,000 hours) with generation, demand, load shedding, generation by fuel (gas, liquid fuel, coal, hydro, solar, wind), imports from India over the Bheramara HVDC, Tripura and Adani links and from Nepal, and translated operator remarks. The other, by Md. Tanvirul Islam on Zenodo, gives raw and cleaned, era-tagged data from 2015 to September 2025 with a documented correction log. Coverage is the national grid of Bangladesh at hourly resolution. Files are downloadable CSV tables under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the Zenodo release warns that load shedding is only disclosed from mid-2022, that demand changes meaning at that point, and that Adani imports were bundled into coal before August 2024; neither release is published by PGCB itself. Simulation uses are demand, shortage and fuel supply analysis and resource adequacy studies. Related records: data-bangladesh-daily-plant-generation-outages gives plant-level detail.
name: Bangladesh hourly power generation, demand, load shedding and fuel mix (compiled from PGCB dispatch reports, 2015-2026)
